what is the need for giving --readKeyword/-r in readHardware ? 
why not just vpd-tool-exe --readHardware --object --record --keyword ?

Well, -H flag is to represent hardware(I think I should define it as hardware rather than readHardware, this is causing the ambiguity)
and -r flag is for read as before, so read flag with hardware flag is read hardware.

coding wise what is the use of giving additional flagoption (--readKeyword). I dont see any dependency of readHardware with readKeyword implementation. 

even with: vpd-tool --readHardware -O <> -R <> -K <> will work fine right? 

well, we can change the name of the option from readKeyword to readFromDbus - if that bothers
